title: Find Champion I
summary: In a tournament with n teams, determine the champion by analyzing a 2D boolean matrix where grid[i][j] indicates team i's strength over team j.
statement: In a tournament with n teams, determine the champion by analyzing a 2D boolean matrix where grid[i][j] indicates team i's strength over team j. The champion is the team with no other team stronger than it.
constraints: grid[i][j]=1 means team i is stronger than team j; diagonal entries are zero.
Exactly one team is not weaker than any other team.
Return that champion team’s zero-based index.
hints: A loss appears as a one in the champion candidate’s column.
Inspect each column for incoming defeats.
Return the only team whose column contains no one outside its diagonal.
The stated champion condition is exactly zero indegree in the directed win graph.
editorial: The stated champion condition is exactly zero indegree in the directed win graph.

tests.explanation: Team zero defeats team one and has no incoming defeat.
Team one defeats both other teams, so its index is one.
